title: Conclusiones sive Theses DCCCC
shelf_note: A Latin incunable of Pico's 900 Theses (Rome 1486, roman type, paragraph marks). It belongs on the Latin language shelf.
structure_note: The counts disagree: structure.pages_translated is 0, but pages_translated_field is 76, and this page has a translation, so the structure count is wrong (E2-type instrument error). with_printed_number is 1 of 89, which fits an unfoliated incunable: this leaf shows no printed number or signature. There are no backsteps or repeats.

book_verdict: The transcription is accurate and the translation is faithful. Most notes are sound glosses of scholastic terms. Two identification notes (Isaac of Narbonne, Abumaron) hedge without adding anything the page supports, but nothing is serious and nothing is wrong on sight; the only structural oddity is the pages_translated count of 0.
